newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS, ROKISHKIS TOP ACTIVITY LIST.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS, ROKISHKIS TOP ACTIVITY LIST.

text.p: The shares of Hermis Bank and Rokishkis Cheese were the most actively traded stocks on the official and A group list of the bourse last week, the stock exchange said on Monday.
Rokishkis Cheese turned over 1.865 million litas on the central market rising 6.67 percent last week to 48 litas.
It was followed by Hermis Bank with turnover of 1.17 million litas showing a 6.12 percent rise and Vilniaus Bank turning over 1.045 million litas on the central market last week.
Hermis Bank also dominated block trades last week turning over 5.85 million litas.
Rokishkis Cheese registered 2.036 million litas business in block trade last week.
Grigishkes paper producer followed Rokishkis with turnover of 1.187 million litas in block trades.
Metalu Komercija gained the most in the A group of the Vilnius bourse, advancing 26.09 percent to 0.29 litas followed by Vilniaus Bank which rose by 15.38 percent to 300 litas last week.
Kalnapilis brewery was up to 7.71 litas by 15.07 percent last week.
Krekenavos Agrocompany , Ukio Bank and Akmenes Cement eased the most in the A group of the Vilnius bourse last week and lost 18.28, 13.73 and 12.86 percent in their price respectively.
